answer: Capped guarantor pairing: a new wallet counts only after a wallet at least 60 epochs old, drawn from the reef of established wallets, locks 4 POA for 30 epochs as its guarantor, and one guarantor backs at most 2 newcomers at a time. An honest user from a cedar community asks one friend and ties up 4 POA; 1,000 fakes need 500 guarantors, so 2,000 POA locked. Fresh fakes cannot vouch for each other because of the age rule. Each epoch 5% of pairs face a live challenge at the check-in jetty; failing forfeits 50% of the lock. Limitation: aged wallets could be rented.
